answer: One workable defense is salted canary tasks. Each epoch the network hides a few honeypot jobs whose output depends on a per-key secret, so no two identities may return the same reply. A farm that clones one answer spreads it like a whisper, and once several keys echo an identical salted output they are linked, flagged and slashed together. Honest agents never notice, since genuine work diverges naturally, the way a river splits around a canyon. The pool is real nectar, so farming stays tempting, but each identity needs its own inference and risks its bond when a canary trips.
